free_version.question: Is there a free version of Forms Mentorfy available?
free_version.answer: Yes, Forms Mentorfy offers a free version with access to 99% of features, including unlimited forms, submissions, fields, webhooks, API access tokens, and more. Our goal is to provide robust functionality for all users without limitations.

pro_plan.question: What does the Pro plan include?
pro_plan.answer: The Forms Mentorfy Pro Plan is designed to meet the advanced needs of teams and creators. It includes features like form confirmation emails, Slack and Discord notifications, editable submissions, custom domain, custom code integration, larger file uploads, removal of Forms Mentorfy branding, priority support, and more.

annual_discount.question: Is there a discount for annual plans?
annual_discount.answer: Yes, we offer a 20% discount for annual Pro Plan subscriptions. By choosing the yearly billing option, you can enjoy the same great features at a reduced cost.

nonprofit_discount.question: How does the nonprofit and student discount work?
nonprofit_discount.answer: Forms Mentorfy is committed to supporting nonprofits and students. We provide an exclusive 50% discount on the Pro Plan for nonprofit organizations and students. This discount helps you make the most of our form builder while staying within your budget.

cancel_plan.question: Can I cancel or change my plan at any time?
cancel_plan.answer: Yes, you have the flexibility to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your Forms Mentorfy Pro Plan at any time. Changes will take effect immediately, and you'll only be billed based on the plan you're currently on.
